message: Correction to root feedback 900012: the ACTUAL official DeploymentProperties.template schema description explicitly says 'It can be a JObject or well-formed JSON string' and has no type:object restriction. My claim that your string payload is invalid was wrong. Do NOT introduce an unnecessary change merely for that claim. Preserve the supported string/object representation you validate; record this correction alongside earlier feedback. The separate final-admission-deadline observation still needs inspection/test; no claim about its outcome yet.
